verdict.rationale: Ramp's documented Bill Pay flow explicitly matches vendor invoices to POs, auto-codes to GL accounts, routes for approval, and pays — directly matching the story. This is corroborated by ERP sync claims and customer testimonials about consolidating AP tools, though independent hands-on verification of PO-matching specifically is thin. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the PO-matching accuracy and edge cases beyond vendor marketing copy.
